_comment: 来源：mod 仓库 _docs/data/units/雷刃旗本兵种设计.md；desc / story 取 loc unit_description_short_texts / unit_description_historical_texts（中英原文）；name.en 照 loc（Thunderblade Hatamoto，设计书里的 Hatamoto of the Thunderblade 已过时）；建筑、同伴名照 loc 官方英文。

role.zh: 精锐近战步兵 · T4 · 大名近卫
role.en: Elite melee infantry · T4 · a daimyo's household guard

v.zh: 双手大太刀（魔法近战，破甲为主）
板甲 100；无实体盾牌，30% 斩箭远程格挡
v.en: Plate, armour 100; no shield, but Deflect Shots gives 30% missile block

v.zh: 侍大将屋形（2 级）／旗本番（2 级）／引雷之峰（地标）；另可经立花直虎的同伴面板以名望征召
v.en: Samurai Taisho's Manor (tier 2) / Hatamoto Guard (2) / Thunder-Drawing Peak (landmark); also bought with Renown through Tachibana Naotora on the Expedition Companions panel

v.zh: 建成上述任一建筑；同伴征召随羁绊档位解锁并给容量
v.en: Building any of the above; the companion option unlocks, and gains capacity, as your Bond tier with her rises

v.zh: 建筑招募无上限；同伴征召容量随羁绊档位
v.en: None from buildings; companion capacity grows with Bond tier

desc.en: The odachi deals mostly armour-piercing damage (35)

desc.zh: 30% 远程格挡——以剑技拨落箭矢，非盾牌格挡，故双手大太刀仍可挡箭
desc.en: 30% missile block: they cut arrows from the air with the blade rather than a shield, so it works even with a two-handed odachi

cth_npex_unit_passive_bushido.zh: 生命值降至 50% 或以下时自动激活：基础／破甲武器杀伤 +15%、近战攻击 +10、永不败逃，持续 25 秒
cth_npex_unit_passive_bushido.en: Triggers at 50% health or below: base and armour-piercing weapon damage +15%, melee attack +10 and Unbreakable, for 25 seconds

cth_npex_unit_passive_blade_unison.zh: 生命值高于 25% 时常驻：近战攻击 +10、近战防御 +10，生命跌破 25% 自动失效
cth_npex_unit_passive_blade_unison.en: Always on above 25% health: melee attack +10, melee defence +10; lost once health drops below 25%
